apps.versionDescription:
[YTKACE] YouTube 21.43.5 | YTKACE_21.43.5_1.1.4

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
#### A new free YouTube enhancer for iOS with downloads, iSponsorBlock, DeArrow, player controls, and interface customization.
> [!NOTE]
> - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K is available.
> - [v1.1.4 release notes](https://github.com/itzzace/ytkace/releases/tag/v1.1.4)
> - Set Download Button to Both in settings to enable downloads. 
> - Set Liquid glass in YTKACE settings to YT liquid glass
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `VolumeBoostYT` `Gonerino` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - make sure you reapply tweak by pressing ✔ again after every sideload so background play/pip and cast work. 

> [!WARNING]
> - Extra tweaks that are bundled may be unstable on newer versions.

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
